headline: 美国期货市场报告：能源供需、库存与美元利率驱动下的实证研究框架
summary: 本期报告聚焦美国相关期货市场，基于美国能源信息署（EIA）最新数据，梳理能源与商品领域的供需、库存、期限结构及美元与利率驱动因素。报告指出，美加能源贸易额下降但天然气与电力贸易逆势增长，反映价格与贸易量分化；ERCOT电力峰值负荷创新高，凸显电力需求与供给压力；中国原油进口下降缓和了霍尔木兹海峡供应中断对油价的推升，影响全球及美国原油平衡；墨西哥LNG出口能力提升，改变北美天然气出口格局；美国汽车电动化结构变化影响汽油需求。这些因素共同作用于美国能源期货价格，需结合美元与利率环境进行实证检验。

items.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
items.source_summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased slightly primarily because of increased natural gas prices and trade volume.
items.headline: 美加天然气与电力贸易额逆势增长，价格与贸易量齐升
items.summary: EIA数据显示，2025年美加能源贸易总额下降11%至约1370亿美元，但天然气和电力贸易额因价格上涨和贸易量增加而小幅上升。
items.significance: 天然气贸易额增长反映美国天然气出口需求强劲，可能影响美国天然气期货（如Henry Hub）的供需平衡与价格预期。
items.empirical_question: 美加天然气贸易额增长是否主要由价格驱动而非贸易量？其增长对美国天然气库存变化和期货期限结构有何影响？在美元升值和利率上升环境下，该贸易增长能否持续？

items.title: Hourly peak load in ERCOT set a new record, exceeding 91 GW on July 22
items.source_summary: Hourly peak load in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT), the regional transmission organization serving most of Texas, reached a record 91.1 gigawatts (GW) on July 22, 2026, according to data reported to us for our Hourly Electric Grid Monitor.

items.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
items.source_summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softening the upward price effects from the disrupted supply through the strait.

items.title: Lower crude oil prices reduced U.S.-Canada energy trade value in 2025
items.source_summary: The value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau. Energy trade value is the total value of energy imports and exports between two countries and is driven by commodity volumes and prices. Most of the U.S.-Canada trade value is U.S. energy imports from Canada—$111 billion in 2025—rather than from U.S. energy exports to Canada, which totaled $26 billion last year. Crude oil accounts for the largest component of U.S.-Canada energy trade, making up 69% of the total value traded in 2025.

items.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
items.source_summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of nominal export capacity from a single train, tripling Mexico's LNG export capacity. The facility is the first terminal in Mexico and the second in North America, following LNG Canada, to be located on the Pacific Coast, boosting North American export capacity there to 2.2 Bcf/d. The Pacific Coast location allows for shorter shipping routes to importers in Asia.

items.title: Hybrid sales rise while battery electric sales remain lower after tax credit expiration
items.source_summary: In the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, up from 22% in 2Q25. Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.
